classification: Retrospective exploratory candidate, not native-session reproduction or untouched evidence
sources: Downloaded Yahoo completed one-minute bars; native yields unavailable intraday
evaluation_sessions: 2026-10-12 through 2026-10-15; October 14-15 market narrative already inspected

hmm.features: log return, prior 20-observation volatility, log volume change; train-only scaling; recursive forward filter

outcome_label: SPY return over next 15 complete minutes below -0.2%; an evaluation label, not a causal macro regime or execution result
economic_diagnostic: Non-overlapping 30-minute SPY opportunities at session minute 30,60,...,330. Decide at t, enter at next bar close, exit 30 minutes later. Compare accepting all with abstaining on each stress signal. Report assumed 2 and 5 bps per side. Not native strategy fills, slippage measurement or profitability proof.
threshold_selection: No parameter search or outcome-based tuning in this experiment
native_comparison: Full original session logs and provider timestamps required for latency attribution. Native HMM model identity absent; use labelled adapted HMM rather than claiming reproduction.
stop_rule: One bounded diagnostic run, fix only correctness defects. No promotion from these four dates. Subsequent shadow study needs source-qualified inputs and untouched sessions.
